synthesis.executive_summary: 今日论文显示，文档解析研究正从单一OCR向结构理解、视觉语义描述和端到端可审计系统演进。RPD基准和P2TPO分别推动统一解析评测与强化学习优化，LoC和ZoomCap则证明高分辨率视觉证据与自适应缩放对RAG和细粒度描述的价值。同时，医疗文档的确定性流水线和semCER评估指标凸显了在受监管场景中可复现性与人类感知对齐的重要性。DocPilot和ReviewPilot展示了智能体在长文档与系统综述中的落地潜力。
synthesis.trend_summary: 整体趋势包括：1）文档解析任务定义趋向统一，要求模型同时输出布局、阅读顺序、文本和视觉元素描述；2）视觉令牌预算、自适应缩放和证据路由成为提升多模态文档理解的关键手段；3）强化学习被用于解决全页解析中的局部错误与信用分配问题；4）评估指标从单纯字符错误率转向严重性加权和事实级可恢复性；5）受监管领域对全流程确定性和可追溯性提出工程要求；6）智能体编排与课程学习开始应用于长文档和系统综述。
common_innovations: 统一文档解析任务定义，将视觉元素描述生成与布局、阅读顺序、文本内容整合为有序列表输出。
利用自适应视觉缩放和高分辨率证据增强来提升细粒度描述与多模态RAG的生成质量。

将P2TPO的信用分配机制与轻量级专用解析模型结合，探索在低资源语言和复杂表格上的优化效果。

构建OCR后结构化信息抽取的智能体系统，结合ReviewPilot的可追溯性设计，提升文档证据链的完整性。
engineering_takeaways: 在文档RAG系统中优先扩大生成器的视觉令牌预算并叠加查询相关OCR文本，可无需训练获得显著提升。

papers.title: Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation
papers.summary: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD
papers.zh_summary: 针对文档理解系统评估割裂、视觉语义连接弱的问题，构建了统一文档解析基准 RPD，要求模型对页面图像输出包含布局、阅读顺序、文本内容和视觉元素替代文本的有序列表。基准包含 2402 篇文档、18163 页、125218 个布局元素和 11338 个视觉实例，并提出即插即用空间感知增强模块，利用多层视觉特征和网格感知空间引导提升布局感知生成。实验表明现有系统难以同时恢复阅读顺序和视觉语义，增强模型取得强联合性能。
papers.novelty: 首次将文档解析中的视觉元素描述生成任务统一到页面级有序列表输出中，并发布大规模细粒度标注基准。
innovation_points: 提出统一文档解析任务定义：输出有序布局元素列表，同时包含边界框、语义标签、阅读顺序索引、文本内容和视觉元素替代文本描述
构建 RPD 基准数据集，涵盖 2402 篇文档、18163 连续页面、125218 个布局元素和 11338 个视觉实例
设计即插即用的空间感知增强器，通过重用多层视觉特征并向视觉语言令牌注入网格感知空间引导，增强布局感知生成
papers.limitations: 未明确说明数据集的语言覆盖范围和领域分布；空间感知增强器未在非英文文档上验证；评估仅限端到端 VLM 和流水线解析器，未涉及轻量级专用模型。
papers.engineering_value: 为文档智能系统提供可复用的统一解析评测基准和增强模块，有助于推动端到端文档解析产品在结构还原和视觉语义理解上的集成。
papers.why_relevant: 直接关乎 OCR 和文档解析任务，涉及阅读顺序、布局分析、文本识别与视觉元素描述的统一建模，与 OCR 研究核心方向高度相关。

papers.title: Making every stage of medical device document assessment with large language models deterministic
papers.summary: To show that a medical device complies with regulation, experts judge whether documents and records meet each requirement and record the judgment for others to verify. For each assessment item that experts define, large language models could prepare a preliminary assessment: a label such as Satisfied or Not satisfied, a reason and quoted evidence. We sent fourteen commercial deployments of such models (seven models from three providers, through six routes) the same request repeatedly, with the deterministic sampling settings each accepted; every deployment returned differing assessments for at least one request, and in twelve the label changed. Reducing reasoning where the interface allows it did not reduce the variation, and prompts of retrieved passages removed it only for the smallest models. The same open-weight model was reproducible or not depending only on how it was served. A pipeline we built to be deterministic at every stage -- text extraction and optical character recognition (OCR), chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval and inference -- returned byte-identical output at each stage across reruns, interruptions, edits, machines of one graphics processing unit (GPU) model and days, for blood glucose meter and infusion pump documents. OCR, embedding and approximate retrieval varied when their own serving was not made invariant, and outputs changed with the GPU model and with the inference engine's scheduling settings, which therefore belong in the recorded configuration. End-to-end determinism is achievable and gives a testable basis for audit and change control.
papers.zh_summary: 探讨大语言模型在医疗器械文档评估中的确定性，发现十四个商业部署在确定性采样设置下仍对相同请求返回不同评估结果，其中十二个标签发生变化。构建的端到端确定性流水线（文本提取与 OCR、分块、嵌入、索引、检索、推理）在多次运行、中断、编辑、不同 GPU 和日期下对血糖仪和输液泵文档输出字节级一致结果，但 OCR、嵌入和近似检索在服务未固定时存在变化，GPU 型号和推理引擎调度设置也影响输出。
papers.novelty: 系统评估了商业 LLM 在医疗器械评估中的非确定性，并证明端到端确定性流水线可实现字节级可复现性。
innovation_points: 首次对多种商业 LLM 在合规评估场景下的确定性进行量化测试，揭示即使固定采样设置也广泛存在输出变化
构建覆盖文本提取与 OCR、分块、嵌入、索引、检索和推理的全阶段确定性流水线，实现跨运行、中断、编辑、机器和日期的字节级一致输出
将 GPU 型号和推理引擎调度设置纳入需记录的配置因素，为审计和变更控制提供可测试基础
papers.limitations: 确定性流水线仅在两种医疗设备文档上验证，未扩展到更广泛领域；OCR 和嵌入服务的非确定性来源未完全消除，仅通过固定服务配置规避；未评估确定性对 LLM 评估准确性的影响。
papers.engineering_value: 为医疗等受监管领域的文档自动化评估提供可审计、可复现的工程实现范式，强调配置记录和全链路固定，具有高合规价值。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及 OCR 作为文本提取环节的确定性要求，并讨论推理引擎调度对输出的影响，与 OCR 系统在关键业务中的可复现性直接相关。

papers.title: Loud and Clear: Making Visual Evidence Count in Multimodal Document RAG
papers.summary: Multimodal document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has focused largely on retrieval, yet its answers depend on how well a vision-language model reads the retrieved pages. We find that evidence in retrieved pages remains underused even when the correct pages are retrieved. On SciEGQA oracle pages, five prior methods give the generator 0.7K to 2.7K visual tokens per query on average under a common image processor, yet raising the page-only budget from 1K to 32K improves accuracy by 15.22 points. At a fixed 16K budget, adding ground-truth crops improves accuracy by 3.75 points over page-only input. We study what the generator needs from retrieved pages through two requirements: Loud, making full use of visual token capacity, and Clear, refining the page so that its evidence becomes prominent. For Loud, increasing either the visual token budget or visual fidelity, the image resolution those tokens preserve, improves accuracy with the other held fixed, and full-page scaling outperforms repetition and tiling at matched budgets. For Clear, suppressing surrounding content improves accuracy without enlarging selected regions, and adding OCR of these regions to page images outperforms either input alone. We implement both as Loud and Clear (LoC), which combines higher-resolution pages with OCR from query-relevant regions without ground-truth annotations or additional training. LoC outperforms eight prior methods on SciEGQA, ViDoRe-v3, and MMLongBench-Doc, improving over the strongest, ColQwen3, by 8.88, 3.09, and 4.22 points with the same retriever and generator. It also outperforms its page-only variant under the same visual token budget. These results locate a bottleneck beyond retrieval: how the retrieved pages are given to the generator.
papers.zh_summary: 发现多模态文档 RAG 中检索到的页面证据未被充分利用，生成器视觉令牌预算从 1K 增至 32K 可提升 15.22 个点，加入真值裁剪可提升 3.75 个点。提出 Loud and Clear（LoC）方法，通过提高页面分辨率并叠加查询相关区域的 OCR 文本，无需额外训练或标注，在 SciEGQA、ViDoRe-v3 和 MMLongBench-Doc 上优于八种先前方法，相比最强基线 ColQwen3 分别提升 8.88、3.09 和 4.22 个点。
papers.novelty: 揭示多模态文档 RAG 中生成器对检索页面证据利用不足，并提出无需训练的 LoC 方法同时提升视觉令牌容量和证据清晰度。
innovation_points: 量化分析多模态文档 RAG 中视觉令牌预算和视觉保真度对答案准确率的影响，提出 Loud 和 Clear 两个需求框架
提出 LoC 方法，结合高分辨率页面与查询相关区域的 OCR 文本，无需真值标注或额外训练
在多个文档问答基准上取得一致提升，验证了同时扩大视觉令牌容量和突出证据区域的有效性
papers.limitations: LoC 依赖查询相关区域的选择，可能引入检索错误；未探索端到端训练以优化区域选择和 OCR 融合；仅在英文文档基准上评估。
papers.engineering_value: 为文档 RAG 系统提供无需训练即可显著提升生成质量的工程方案，尤其适用于高分辨率页面和 OCR 文本融合的部署场景。
papers.why_relevant: 核心涉及 OCR 文本与视觉页面在 RAG 中的融合利用，直接关联 OCR 输出如何增强多模态文档理解。

papers.title: ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer
papers.summary: Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, which scores caption-derived atomic claims on two blind anchors--source image (truthfulness) and reconstruction (realizability)--separating fabrication from generator loss claim by claim; human and multi-judge comparisons complement this fact-level view. Against Qwen3.5-397B-A17B captions, ZoomCap achieves an 81.9% human tie-adjusted preference score with a teacher over 10x smaller, and FactCycle counts 52.4 transferred claims per image vs. 31.5 for ScaleCap. The evidence also transfers: in continual pre-training, ZoomCap-450K improves the 11-benchmark average by 1.31-2.38 points over the strongest competing corpus and Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 gains 1.4 points on a production document/OCR monitor suite (1.5 on perception) at 60B tokens; in medical pre-training, 2.64M ZoomCap-captioned images improve five VQA benchmarks by 3.04 points (vs. 1.76 for same-image Gemini-3.1-Pro captions).
papers.zh_summary: 将细粒度图像描述建模为可恢复的视觉信息传递，提出 ZoomCap 方法，利用草稿描述路由条件知识检索、OCR 敏感阅读、覆盖缺口恢复和自适应视觉缩放，将更深裁剪仅分配给最复杂的合格区域。提出 FactCycle 从真值性和可实现性两个盲锚点评估原子声明。ZoomCap 以小于教师模型 10 倍的规模获得 81.9% 的人类偏好得分，FactCycle 统计每图传递 52.4 个声明（ScaleCap 为 31.5）。在持续预训练中，ZoomCap-450K 在 11 个基准上平均提升 1.31-2.38 个点。
papers.novelty: 提出可恢复视觉信息传递框架和自适应视觉缩放机制，以及 FactCycle 事实级评估方法，用于细粒度图像描述。
innovation_points: 将细粒度描述形式化为可恢复视觉信息传递，教师模型在有限观察预算下获取缺失证据并转化为监督信号
提出 ZoomCap，利用草稿描述路由条件知识检索、OCR 敏感阅读、覆盖缺口恢复和自适应视觉缩放，仅对最复杂区域进行深度裁剪
提出 FactCycle 评估方法，基于源图像和重构两个盲锚点分离虚构与生成器损失，实现事实级评分
papers.limitations: 依赖教师模型生成草稿描述，可能继承教师偏差；自适应缩放策略未在多样化文档类型上广泛验证；FactCycle 的自动化评估与人类判断的一致性需进一步验证。
papers.engineering_value: 为视觉语言模型提供高质量细粒度描述数据生成方法，可用于文档/OCR 监控套件的持续预训练，提升感知能力。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及 OCR 敏感阅读和文档/OCR 监控套件，与 OCR 数据生成和增强直接相关。

papers.title: P2TPO: Structure-Aligned Page-to-Token Credit Assignment for Full-Page Document Parsing
papers.summary: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary proxies for within-block omissions while preserving the total block-derived advantage across its tokens. Under a fixed-weight additive page utility, we show that element-indexed contrasts retain local quality differences that page-level aggregation can cancel out. In the main experimental comparison, P2TPO outperforms all evaluated policy optimization baselines in seed-averaged scores on each of the six document parsing benchmarks. Additional experiments demonstrate gains across model scales and initializations.
papers.zh_summary: 针对全页文档解析中局部错误和遗漏问题，提出 Page-to-Token Policy Optimization（P2TPO）结构对齐信用分配框架，在整页策略轨迹上操作。通过参考元素对齐将块级质量对比与生成跨度关联，统一锚点定价处理匹配和缺失元素，跨度信用重分配按对齐的正确和错误跨度重新分配块信用。在六个文档解析基准上，P2TPO 优于所有评估的策略优化基线。
papers.novelty: 提出结构对齐的页面到令牌信用分配方法，解决全页文档解析中页面级优势无法定位局部元素错误的问题。
innovation_points: 引入 P2TPO 框架，在整页策略轨迹上进行结构对齐的信用分配，将块级质量对比与生成文本跨度关联
提出统一锚点定价（UAP），在采样输出获得相同但不完美分数时，结合匹配和缺失元素结果，提供相对于固定质量上限的反馈
设计跨度信用重分配（SCR），根据对齐的正确和错误跨度重新分配块信用，使用边界代理处理块内遗漏，同时保持总块优势不变
papers.limitations: 未明确说明 P2TPO 对初始模型质量的依赖；仅在固定权重加性页面效用下进行理论分析；未探讨在低资源语言或复杂表格上的表现。
papers.engineering_value: 为全页文档解析模型提供细粒度强化学习优化方案，可提升端到端解析系统的局部准确性和结构完整性，适用于高精度文档数字化。
papers.why_relevant: 直接针对文档解析任务，涉及布局元素和阅读顺序的优化，与 OCR 后处理及端到端解析紧密相关。

papers.title: ESG-Kor: A Korean Dataset for ESG-related Information Extraction and Practical Use Cases
papers.summary: With the expansion of pre-trained language model usage in recent years, the importance of datasets for performing tasks in specialized domains has significantly increased. Therefore, we have built a Korean dataset called ESG-Kor to automatically extract Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) information, which has recently gained importance. ESG-Kor is a dataset consisting of a total of 118,946 sentences that extracted information on each ESG component from Korean companies' sustainability reports and manually labeled it according to objective rules provided by ESG evaluation agencies. To verify the effectiveness and applicability of the ESG-Kor dataset, classification performance was confirmed using several Korean pre-trained language models, and significant performance was obtained. Additionally, by extending the ESG classification model to documents of small and medium enterprises and extracting information based on ESG key issues and in-depth analysis, we demonstrated potential and practical use cases in the ESG field.
papers.zh_summary: 构建了韩语 ESG 信息提取数据集 ESG-Kor，包含 118,946 个句子，从韩国公司可持续发展报告中提取 ESG 各组成部分信息，并依据 ESG 评估机构提供的客观规则进行人工标注。使用多个韩语预训练语言模型验证分类性能，并在中小企业文档上扩展 ESG 分类模型，展示基于 ESG 关键议题的信息提取和深入分析的实用案例。
papers.novelty: 发布首个韩语 ESG 信息提取大规模人工标注数据集，并提供面向中小企业的应用案例。
innovation_points: 构建 ESG-Kor 数据集，包含 118,946 个从韩国公司可持续发展报告中提取并人工标注的句子，覆盖环境、社会和治理维度
基于 ESG 评估机构的客观规则进行标注，确保数据一致性和可验证性
验证多个韩语预训练语言模型的分类性能，并将模型扩展到中小企业文档，展示 ESG 关键议题提取的实用用例
papers.limitations: 数据集仅覆盖韩语和韩国公司，跨语言和跨地区泛化性未知；标注规则依赖特定评估机构，可能不适用于其他 ESG 框架；未涉及视觉元素或多模态文档解析。
papers.engineering_value: 为金融和合规领域的 ESG 自动化分析提供韩语数据和基线模型，可应用于中小企业报告的信息提取和风险评估。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及从可持续发展报告中提取信息，与文档解析和 OCR 在金融文档处理中的应用场景相关。

papers.title: DocPilot: Interactive Agent Orchestration and Training for Long Visual Document Understanding
papers.summary: Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. To transfer these capabilities to small models, we propose curriculum-based agentic training that progresses from single-ability learning to adaptive orchestration through supervision from data-grounded reasoning traces and executable interaction trajectories. Across MMLongBench-Doc, DocBench, FinRAGBench-V, and MADQA, DocPilot achieves strong gains with frontier VLM backbones, while DocPilot-4B delivers competitive performance against substantially larger models, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization across diverse long-document reasoning settings. The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot.
papers.zh_summary: 多模态长文档问答需要在跨页和跨模态中定位稀疏证据，并整合异构内容进行推理。现有视觉语言模型（VLM）易忽略稀疏证据，单次推理难以完成跨模态推理；已有文档智能体存在预定义流程或粗粒度动作的限制。本文提出DocPilot，一种智能体文档框架，支持表达性编排，并通过课程式智能体训练使小语言模型（SLM）学习复杂文档求解。DocPilot通过页面级导航和细粒度证据定位来编排证据搜索，并整合局部视觉检查、基于代码的数值推理和跨模态推理。在MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench、FinRAGBench-V和MADQA上，DocPilot与前沿VLM骨干结合取得显著提升，DocPilot-4B与更大模型相比具有竞争力。
papers.novelty: 提出DocPilot智能体框架，通过页面级导航和细粒度证据定位实现表达性编排，并设计课程式智能体训练将复杂文档推理能力迁移至小模型。
innovation_points: 支持页面级导航与细粒度证据定位的智能体编排机制
整合局部视觉检查、代码数值推理与跨模态推理的多模态理解流程
课程式智能体训练：从单能力学习到自适应编排的渐进训练范式
基于数据接地推理轨迹和可执行交互轨迹的监督信号设计
papers.limitations: 未明确说明在开放域或低资源语言文档上的泛化能力；依赖教师模型生成轨迹，训练成本可能较高；未讨论对超长文档（如数百页）的扩展性。
papers.engineering_value: 为长文档问答系统提供可训练的智能体框架，使小模型也能达到接近大模型的性能，降低部署成本，适用于金融、法律等领域的文档理解场景。
papers.why_relevant: 论文关注长视觉文档理解，涉及OCR后的文档问答与推理，与OCR技术在实际文档分析中的应用密切相关。

papers.title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
papers.summary: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.
papers.zh_summary: 本文提出CommerceGen-Studio，一个端到端框架，用于为电商SKU生成商业级主图。框架分为信息提取、语义重写和多条件生成三阶段：Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent（PERL-Agent）通过VLM和LLM角色的迭代闭环，从异构SKU元数据中提炼卖点文本列表；Layout Thinker Optimization（LTO）通过交替领域策略优化对齐重写器与标题及渲染图像质量；SKU-DiT在Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce（RDR）渐进训练下，联合以白底产品图、商标裁剪和结构化布局为条件，保持主体保真度、商标完整性和字符级文本准确性。系统每日可生成数百万张主图，每张延迟仅几秒，并发布CommerceGen-Bench基准。
papers.novelty: 提出面向电商主图生成的端到端框架，通过多阶段智能体优化和渐进训练实现商业规模部署。
innovation_points: PERL-Agent：基于VLM/LLM迭代闭环的卖点提炼与评估机制
LTO：交替领域策略优化对齐重写器与图像质量
SKU-DiT：基于RDR渐进训练的多条件生成模型，联合优化主体、商标和文本保真度
发布CommerceGen-Bench硬案例基准，覆盖全品类实时流量
papers.limitations: 未详细说明模型对复杂背景或低质量输入图像的鲁棒性；未讨论生成图像的知识产权与合规风险；基准仅针对电商场景，泛化性有限。
papers.engineering_value: 提供可落地的电商主图生成方案，支持大规模生产，显著降低人工设计成本，对电商平台有直接应用价值。
papers.why_relevant: 论文涉及图像生成中的文本准确性和布局控制，与OCR中的文本识别与生成技术有交叉，尤其在字符级文本准确性方面。

papers.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
papers.summary: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.
papers.zh_summary: 字符错误率（CER）是OCR和视觉语言模型的标准指标，但将拼写错误与错误名称同等计分。本文提出semCER，保留CER的对齐和分母，为每个字素编辑赋予由LLM评判的严重性分数，无需分词。归一化CER保持整个转录的分数，semCER将其分解为命名编辑。在英语、越南语和中文中，收费与读者评分逐编辑一致，并将读者认为最严重的编辑排在排序列表顶部。在CER与semCER不一致的样本上，读者更常支持semCER。在16种语言中，评判者对错误变音符号或声调符号的收费因语言而异。释放6100万个评判编辑、聚合读者评分和蒸馏评分器。
papers.novelty: 提出严重性加权的字符错误率（semCER），通过LLM评判为每个编辑赋予严重性分数，更贴近人类感知。
innovation_points: 保留CER对齐和分母，引入LLM评判的编辑严重性权重
无需分词，适用于多语言
将整体分数分解为命名编辑，提供可解释性
发布大规模评判编辑数据集和蒸馏评分器
papers.limitations: 依赖LLM评判，可能引入评判偏差或成本；未讨论实时应用中的效率问题；严重性评分的主观性可能影响一致性。
papers.engineering_value: 为OCR系统提供更贴近人类感知的评估指标，有助于优化模型在关键信息（如名称、数字）上的准确性，提升下游应用可靠性。
papers.why_relevant: 直接针对OCR评估指标提出改进，与OCR技术核心评估方法密切相关。

papers.title: Learning from Interaction Experience via Localized Context Distillation
papers.summary: Learning from interaction experience is essential for enabling large language models to continually improve during deployment. Context distillation offers a promising path: privileged information extracted from experience is provided to a teacher, whose behavior is then distilled into a student model that has no access to it. However, both existing forms of context distillation have limitations. Off-policy context distillation trains the student on teacher-generated trajectories and thus suffers from exposure bias; whereas on-policy context distillation trains on the student's own rollouts, whose states are often uninformative and fail to convey behaviors the student cannot yet produce. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Localized Context Distillation (LoCD). LoCD first localizes the critical spans of a student trajectory that require revision. The teacher then regenerates only these spans from the student's own prefix, and the student is trained on the regenerated segments. LoCD thereby concentrates learning on the most informative states while keeping exposure bias low. Extensive experiments across math reasoning, code generation, and agent tasks demonstrate that LoCD consistently outperforms strong baselines and achieves more stable training with smaller and sparser parameter updates.
papers.zh_summary: 从交互经验中学习对于大语言模型在部署中持续改进至关重要。上下文蒸馏提供了一条路径：将特权信息提供给教师，然后蒸馏到无访问权限的学生。然而，离策略上下文蒸馏存在暴露偏差，而在策略上下文蒸馏使用学生自身轨迹，状态信息量低。本文提出局部上下文蒸馏（LoCD），首先定位学生轨迹中需要修订的关键片段，教师仅根据学生前缀重新生成这些片段，学生基于重新生成的片段训练。LoCD将学习集中在信息量最大的状态，同时保持低暴露偏差。在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上，LoCD优于强基线，训练更稳定，参数更新更小更稀疏。
papers.novelty: 提出局部上下文蒸馏（LoCD），通过定位关键片段并由教师重新生成，平衡暴露偏差与信息量。
innovation_points: 局部化学生轨迹中需要修订的关键片段
教师基于学生前缀重新生成关键片段，学生训练于重新生成的片段
在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上验证有效性
实现更稳定训练和更小更稀疏的参数更新
papers.limitations: 未详细说明关键片段定位的准确性和鲁棒性；未讨论在长文本或多轮交互中的扩展性；实验主要集中在特定任务，泛化性需进一步验证。
papers.engineering_value: 为模型持续学习提供高效训练范式，可应用于需要交互式改进的OCR系统，如文档问答智能体的在线优化。
papers.why_relevant: 虽不直接涉及OCR，但为交互式文档理解系统的持续学习提供方法，可间接提升OCR下游任务性能。

papers.title: ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
papers.summary: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. Case studies in biomedicine and human-computer interaction show close agreement with human annotators, suggesting that ReviewPilot can transfer beyond epidemiology. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot.
papers.zh_summary: 系统文献综述遵循PRISMA流程，包括筛选学术作品和提取证据。基于LLM的深度研究工具可以搜索和总结文献，但不记录排除的研究或提取值的来源。本文开发了会话式多智能体系统ReviewPilot，自动化从论文筛选到信息提取的PRISMA工作流。研究人员可以通过对话定制标准和模式，项目记忆保存配置和修订。每个筛选决策附带理由，每个提取值附带来源。在流行病学专家综述上，ReviewPilot在三个LLM上优于单提示LLM和AgentSLR，筛选宏F1达0.776，提取F1达0.788。生物医学和HCI案例研究显示与人类标注者高度一致。
papers.novelty: 提出会话式多智能体系统ReviewPilot，自动化PRISMA工作流，提供可追溯的筛选和提取。
innovation_points: 多智能体会话式系统，支持通过对话定制标准和模式
项目记忆保存配置和修订
每个筛选决策附带理由，每个提取值附带来源
在流行病学综述上超越单提示LLM和AgentSLR
papers.limitations: 未讨论对非英语文献的处理能力；未评估在跨学科领域的泛化性；依赖LLM可能引入偏见；未涉及大规模文献的处理效率。
papers.engineering_value: 为系统文献综述提供自动化工具，提高筛选和提取效率，可应用于需要文档信息提取的领域，如OCR后的结构化信息抽取。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及文档筛选和信息提取，与OCR后的文档理解任务相关，可借鉴其多智能体架构。
